$comment: Product-facing rewrites of schema descriptions that carry too much internal history to render as they are (plan names, ticket ids). An entry here wins over the schema description. See meanings-concept.json for the file format.

slots.autoPanelSurface.visibleWhen: Typed predicates that show or hide a region of the aggregate workbench, keyed by collection or band name (for example `"itens": "$root.tipo != 'CANCELLED'"`). Predicates may combine clauses with `&&` and `||` and may read `$root.<field>` and `$ui.<name>`. Presentation only: a hidden collection's rows still commit unchanged, and this never gates persistence or authorization.
slots.autoPanelSurface.bandPickers: Modal row pickers for the bands (collections) of the aggregate workbench, keyed by band collection name. A picker may name a selection panel, or give only `filter` and `multiSelect` and use no panel.
slots.workbenchBandPicker.selectorRef: Name of a `screens` entry of kind `picker` whose columns, filters, order and `where` are adopted wholesale. This picker's own `filter`, if also given, is combined with the picker screen's using AND.
slots.field.sensitive: Marks the field as sensitive. It is redacted before it can appear in any external-AI review pack, by field name across all concepts (it deliberately over-redacts rather than risk missing one). At runtime a sensitive field with no `access.read` rule of its own is omitted from every generated read, list and query response for every caller (administrators included), is never offered to agent tools or search, and is redacted in audit trails. Declaring `access.read` on the field is the explicit grant that returns it to whoever passes the rule.
slots.flowStep.parallelAwait: On a `forEach`: waits for all iterations in parallel instead of one at a time. Every iteration's await is attempted up front and all outstanding ones stay durably parked at once. The body must contain exactly one `awaitEvent` step at its top level (not nested in a branch); any number of other non-`forEach` steps may come before or after it. Absent or false means sequential.
slots.flowStep.timeout: On an `awaitEvent`: the wait deadline in seconds, measured from when the step first parks (not from flow start). It survives a process restart; once it passes without the awaited event the flow resumes into `onTimeout`. Absent means wait forever.
slots.flowStep.onFailure: Compensation steps, run in reverse completion order if a later step of the same flow fails terminally. Best-effort cleanup in the saga style, not a distributed transaction.
slots.panelLayout.slots: Hand-authored regions inside this generated panel. Each slot mounts an app-owned component (`web/regions/<component>.js`, registered with `window.npdev.regions.register`) above, below or in place of the generated body, and is handed the panel's live data through a narrowed API (panel, data, refresh, invoke).
slots.pack:packs: Transitive pack dependencies. `version` is a minimal constraint: an exact version (`2.0.3`) or a caret constraint (`^2.0`, same major, minor and patch at least as high). An entry may also declare `from` (a remote coordinate, same grammar as the model's `packRef.from`) or `$ref` (a local file); with neither, the local file `packs/<packId>/pack.json` is used.
slots.workbenchBandPicker.filter: An AND-composed predicate (`field == literal && field == literal`) constraining the candidate rows, enforced server-side; a literal may be `$root.<field>`, the aggregate's root record. The same shape a plain reference field's picker declares.
slots.screen.query: Name of a `queries` entry whose rows the screen shows; bind its parameters with `params`.
slots.screen.component: With `kind: custom`: the name of the app component, registered with `window.npdev.regions.register`.

inline.field.picker.filter: An AND-composed predicate (`field == literal && field == literal`) constraining the picker's candidate rows; a literal may be `$root.<field>`, the aggregate's root record (or, with no enclosing aggregate, the field's own record). Enforced server-side. OR is not supported; use a `visibleWhen` predicate instead.
inline.field.picker.selectorRef: Name of a `screens` entry of kind `picker` whose columns, filters, order and `where` are adopted wholesale. This picker's own `filter`, if also given, is combined with the picker screen's using AND.
